description: Styracosaurus ("spiked lizard") was a herbivore dinosaur of the Late Cretaceous (76-75 million years ago), reaching about 5.5 m. Neck frill ringed with long spikes. # Styracosaurus — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What does the name Styracosaurus mean?", "spiked lizard"),

    ("What is found in?", "North America"),

        print("Correct.")
        score += 1

        print(f"Answer: {a}")
